headline: A mix of noise pollution, animal neglect, and urban chaos highlight this week's most memorable Austin complaints.

picks.text: Why do I hear Luna’s bass and screaming all the way from the 40th floor? This is insane. My apartment is literally shaking from the music.
picks.editorialNote: A 40th-floor apartment shaking from Luna's bass and screaming shows extreme noise pollution in Austin's high-rises.
